priorityList.notes: Arcane Power on cooldown: a flat 30 percent damage cooldown with no cast time of its own.
Presence of Mind on cooldown: free (no GCD) and makes the next cast instant.
Missile Barrage is the talent proc that empowers your next Arcane Missiles cast -- fire the empowered Missiles under it, where the Arcane guide places the payoff.

Arcane Blast to 3 stacks, then on while mana is ahead of the fight and above 20%. Ahead of the fight means a larger share of the mana bar left than of the fight. Client 1.60.1.70707 cut each stack's cost increase to 100% (was 175%) and the buff lasts 18 sec, so a mana-rich mage keeps blasting at 4 stacks instead of breaking to Frostbolt; a mage behind pace stops at 3 and Frostbolts, as before. In the 70707 run: about +10% at the raid band, within about half a percent at the bare band.

Frostbolt is the filler once the Blast line stops. It is a cheaper, faster cast than Arcane Missiles, the Blast stacks' spell damage still applies to it, and it has a 20% chance to proc Missile Barrage. Frostbolt fills until the 18 second Blast buff runs out, and the next Blast starts a fresh, cheap set. Before Arcane Blast is learned, Arcane Missiles spam is the whole rotation.

Shoot only when nothing else can be cast, which in practice means out of mana: a wand shot cannot start during the global cooldown and holds you for the wand's full speed, so it never fits between spells.
